title: Constellation Diagram
text: Display and analyze input signals in IQ-plane, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Reference constellation} sets Reference constellation; {Settings} sets the constellation diagram settings, {Number of input ports}, {Samples per symbol} sets the number of samples used to represent each, {Offset} sets the number of samples to skip before plotting, {Symbols to display} sets the maximum number of symbols to display Input frame, {AxesLimits} sets the x and y -axis limits, {Reference Constellation} sets the reference constellation configuration, {Show reference constellations} sets the option to display reference constellations, {Input} selects input port, {Custom value} sets the input reference constellation, {Constellation normalization} sets the normalization method Average, {Average reference power} sets the average power of reference constellation, {Reference phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset of reference constellation, {Legend} sets the option to display, {Trajectory} sets the option to display signal, {Channel} sets the active input channel name of first channel in first, {Measurement Interval} sets the duration of EVM and MER measurement Current, {EVM Normalization} sets the normalization method Average constellation and {EVM/MER} sets the option to display signal quality measurements pane. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In_1,..., In_N
ports.summary: Signals (as separate ports) column vectors | matrices

params.name: Settings
params.values: Constellation diagram settings button

params.name: Number of input ports
params.values: Number of input ports on scope block 1 (default) | integer in the range [1, 20]

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples used to represent each symbol 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Offset
params.values: Number of samples to skip before plotting points 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Symbols to display
params.values: Maximum number of symbols to display Input frame length (default) | positive integer

params.name: AxesLimits
params.values: x and y -axis limits [-1.375 1.375] (default) | two-element row vector

params.name: Reference Constellation
params.values: Reference constellation configuration button

params.name: Show reference constellations
params.values: Option to display reference constellations on (default) | off

params.name: Input
params.values: Select input port 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Reference constellation
params.values: Reference constellation Custom (default) | BPSK | 8-PSK | 16-QAM | 64-QAM | 256-QAM

params.name: Custom value
params.values: Input reference constellation [0.7071+0.7071i -0.7071+0.7071i -0.7071-0.7071i 0.7070-0.7071i] (default) | vector

params.name: Constellation normalization
params.values: Normalization method Average power (default) | Minimum distance | Peak power

params.name: Average reference power
params.values: Average power of reference constellation 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reference phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset of reference constellation scalar

params.name: Channel
